ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Renewals and expansion, Outreach and later stages need Renewal risk and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Renewals_expansion", CASE(StageName, "Upcoming", 1, "Outreach", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Negotiation (Renewals and expansion)", 4, "Awaiting signature", 5, "Renewed", 6, 0) >= 2, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Renewal_risk__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Renewal risk and Next step date before moving to Outreach.
